title: MV Help: How do I do Flat Regen with Yanfly Buffs And States Core

posts.author: Someweirdguy05
posts.body:
I'm using Yanfly's "Buffs And States Core", and I want to make a status effect, armor, whatever, that regenerates a flat number of hp/mp. I don't want to regenerate 20% of my max hp. I want to regenerate 20 hp, regardless of what my max hp is.
thank you in advance

posts.author: Zypter
posts.body: You would also need the "Extended Damage Over Time" plugin, an extension for BaS Core, it has instructions on the notetags for what you need in there.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Zypter said:
You would also need the "Extended Damage Over Time" plugin, an extension for BaS Core, it has instructions on the notetags for what you need in there.
Click to expand...
False. While I personally also like using the extended DoT plugin, it's completely possible to do this with just BaS Core. Simply put this in your state's notetag:
Code:
<Custom Turn End Effect>
target.gainHp(20);
</Custom Turn End Effect>
(Or use <Custom Regenerate Effect> to make it happen alongside the regular regeneration effects going on. Not too much of a difference usually, but it's best to be accurate.)
To have such an effect on equipment, you'd need a different plugin.
http://yanfly.moe/2015/10/17/yep-13-auto-passive-states/
for example should be able to accomplish this.
